title: Completed work waits for paperwork

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: Technicians use paper or photos, and office staff retype reports for each customer. Signatures or device identifiers are missing. Chargeable jobs wait for invoices even though repairs are complete. Sometimes the contact is absent when work finishes.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: 16 staff; institutional customers require service documents before invoicing.

discriminating_questions.question: Which fields actually block invoicing?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Device, work description and acceptance evidence vary by customer.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: If complete reports are waiting on a customer’s payment dispute, automating documents does not resolve the commercial issue.

discriminating_questions.question: When are omissions discovered?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: During office transcription, often the next day.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: What does a signature mean?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Usually acceptance of the described work, not merely attendance.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: What if the contact is absent?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Technicians leave a blank signature and the office chases it.
discriminating_questions.diagnostic_value: A legitimate pending state is needed.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: Evidence capture is disconnected from customer document requirements and acceptance workflow.
counterexample: If complete reports are waiting on a customer’s payment dispute, automating documents does not resolve the commercial issue.
minimum_evidence: A simulated report lacks a device ID.
A simulated invoice hold cites missing acceptance.
A simulated template review shows differing required fields.
process_intervention: Use a short on-site checklist aligned to required evidence; represent completed work and accepted work separately.
automation_candidate: Capture structured notes and evidence once; render reviewed customer templates; queue missing acceptance for follow-up.
unknowns: Customer submission formats, signatory authority and portal integration feasibility need confirmation.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Structured completion capture and template rendering extend scanned-form extraction.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
